note: One source for what a plan is (18.5 / 11.3). Read by the migration that
fills the plan table, and - from stage 2 - by the marketing site's build,
so what is offered and what is marketed cannot drift.
Nothing reads this at run time. The application reads the plan table, and
the site renders static HTML at build. A page that fetched its own prices
from JavaScript would have nothing to say with JavaScript off.
ENTERPRISE CARRIES NULL WHERE A NUMBER WOULD BE A PRICE, and the string
the pricing page prints everywhere else. monthly_price_cents is null
because a negotiated price must not be a release (CLAUDE.md, Money); the
site's word for that null is 'negotiated'. It is also the one plan with no
paddle_price_name, because it is not bought in the product.
ENTERPRISE IS NOT A plan ROW, and migration 033 does not make it one.
plan.seat_count, monthly_price_cents and monthly_credit_cents are all NOT
NULL, so a row for it could only exist by inventing three numbers - which
is the release the decision forbids. It lives here, and stage 2 renders it
